candidates: Arm64EC Wine/Proton + FEXCore (HODLL64=libarm64ecfex.dll) — preferred candidate, runtime not yet device-tested

Arm64EC Wine/Proton + WowBox64 (HODLL64=wowbox64.dll) — separate 64-bit fallback candidate
Arm64EC Wine/Proton + FEXCore WoW64 (HODLL=libwow64fex.dll) — preferred candidate; runtime/device tests pending
Box64 BOX32 + matching 32-bit Wine/WoW64 — Android ARM64 BOX32 executable now built and checksum-verified; 32-bit x86 ELF execution and Windows PE/AEX hosting are not yet verified
Boxedwine Android ARM64 port — independent legacy fallback candidate; Android app port still required
Arm64EC Wine/Proton container; verify PE and imported ABI before selection
Manual compatibility review; do not assume ARM64EC compatibility
Native ARM64 runtime if the host/plugin ABI is actually ARM64

ae_plugin_host.name: aexlo
ae_plugin_host.role: Windows x64 After Effects Effect API host shim; run as an isolated PE worker inside Wine/Box64 or Arm64EC Wine/FEXCore
ae_plugin_host.upstream_status: heavy development; incomplete suites and features remain
ae_plugin_host.platform_note: upstream targets Windows x64 and macOS arm64; Windows x64 worker must run under the Android Windows compatibility container

alternative_backends.role: Third execution fallback for x86-64 Linux Wine binaries on Android ARM64; it translates Linux ELF execution, not Windows PE directly
limitations: requires a compatible x86-64 Wine/glibc rootfs
slower than dynarec backends in expected workloads
must bundle and audit runtime shared-library dependencies

alternative_backends.role: Optional Android ARM64 OpenCL 3.0 implementation layered on Vulkan, for plug-ins whose OpenCL usage can be bridged through Wine
limitations: compiler-disabled build supports only precompiled SPIR-V paths
full runtime OpenCL C compilation needs clspv/LLVM
Wine OpenCL ICD bridge to Android ARM64 driver is unverified
does not implement CUDA

alternative_backends.role: Development-only PE/API emulation and dynamic instrumentation to identify imported Windows APIs and missing host shims
limitations: Python tooling, not suitable as the main frame-rendering runtime
not an AE host; still needs AE SDK suite shims
keep outside shipping APK unless GPL and size implications are intentionally accepted

alternative_backends.role: Independent robust PE/COFF parser for validating imports, exports, sections, symbols and machine architecture
limitations: analysis/parsing only; does not execute Windows code or provide Windows APIs

alternative_backends.role: Optional Box64 build with BOX32=ON, supporting 32-bit x86 Linux ELF programs inside the 64-bit ARM64 Box64 process
limitations: supports 32-bit Linux ELF userland, not Windows PE by itself
still requires a compatible 32-bit Wine/WoW64 configuration to host 32-bit Windows AEX plug-ins

alternative_backends.role: Developer-side static reverse-engineering of closed-source x86/x64 AEX PE binaries: disassembly, decompilation, call graphs, imports, render routines and API use
limitations: not a production runtime
does not automatically reconstruct original source or effect algorithms
dynamic traces still require a compatible Wine/Box64/FEX execution environment

alternative_backends.license: GPL-2.0 (upstream README; audit individual file notices and bundled libraries)
alternative_backends.role: Separate x86 CPU + Linux-kernel + 32-bit Wine environment, with ARMv8 JIT; candidate for legacy 16/32-bit Windows plug-ins
limitations: No ready-made upstream Android app build target is documented
Current upstream target list is Windows, macOS, Linux and Emscripten
Not a 64-bit AEX execution solution
Still needs an AE plug-in host ABI such as a compatible 32-bit aexlo host
GPL-2.0 distribution obligations require a separate legal/source-release review

rootfs_strategy.method: Extract a verified compressed Wine/glibc rootfs into EffectCraft's private files directory; launch Box64 directly with explicit LD_LIBRARY_PATH and BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH, following Winlator's Android RootFS and GuestProgramLauncher pattern

proot_optional.role: Optional path redirection and chroot-like rootfs view where the direct launcher is insufficient

rootfs_manager.role: Reference for rootfs bootstrap, architecture selection and QEMU user-mode handling

graphics_backends.role: OpenGL compatibility through selected Mesa driver path (Zink/Turnip/VirGL where supported)
OpenCL 3.0 on Vulkan for compatible OpenCL plug-ins
graphics_backends.status: experimental; Wine bridge and runtime compiler need verification
not currently solved for ordinary Android GPUs

winlator_bionic_runtime.license_caveat: MIT applies to the fork's source code only. Ubuntu ImageFS, Wine/Proton, Box64, FEXCore, WowBox64, Mesa, DXVK, VKD3D and other runtime assets retain their own licenses and NOTICE/source obligations.

base_imagefs.role: Ubuntu Bionic userland and ARM64 Android helper libraries, including Wine/graphics runtime layout

wine_runtimes.purpose: Standard x86-64 Windows PE execution through Wine/Proton and Box64

wine_runtimes.launcher: <proton-bin>/<guest-executable> (native ARM64EC Wine/Proton path, no Box64 wrapper)
wine_runtimes.purpose: ARM64EC Wine/Proton with FEXCore or WowBox64 Windows WoW64 emulator DLL selected via HODLL

fexcore.role: ARM64EC and 32-bit WoW64 DLLs; extract into the matching prefix system32

wowbox64.role: Alternative 32-bit WoW64 DLL; extract into the matching prefix system32

install_flow: Download ImageFS and Proton runtime archives from upstream and verify their SHA-256 sidecars before extraction.
Extract ImageFS into the app-private files/imagefs directory.
Create a separate private Wine prefix per EffectCraft compatibility container by extracting the pinned matching container-pattern archive.
Install common Windows DLLs for x86-64/ARM64EC and i386 from the Wine runtime into system32/syswow64 as the upstream ContainerManager does.
For ARM64EC, extract FEXCore or WowBox64 emulator DLLs into the selected prefix system32 and set HODLL consistently.
Launch the Windows AE host worker in its own supervised process using the architecture-specific launcher.
Preserve logs and allow switching to another backend/prefix if a plugin fails.

memory_policy.video_memory_limit: Use 0/driver default; never impose an arbitrary fixed cap for plug-in compatibility

current_runtime_wcp.mutable_alias: nightly-latest (all package assets remain SHA-256 and size pinned)
current_runtime_wcp.install_policy: Download each WCP to private runtime storage, verify pinned SHA-256 and expected size, parse profile.json and allow only pre-approved destinations. The nightly-latest alias is mutable; reject any payload whose SHA-256 or size differs from this manifest.
